title: On-screen demo analyses' flags/positives have zero coverage despite new pin claiming both copies are pinned
detail: The pin only reads pdf_prebake payloads; no client test reads demo_store.analysis_for (grep of client/test confirms zero assertions on demo flags). Reverting the on-screen arrays ships green — W1's PDF-vs-screen disagreement returns undetected. P1 tier: 67%.
recommended_fix: Add a client test asserting demo_store.application_detail analyses' flags/positives equal the canonical arrays — the mirror of the server-side pin.

title: Ported competition_ranks tie and unscored-tail branches, plus compare_apps NULLS LAST, untested in demo_store
detail: Every demo_store.leaderboard test uses v-maples (8 distinct scores); the server original has tie/unscored-tail/offset tests, the port has none. A divergent port of tie-sharing, None ranks, or NULLS-LAST ordering ships green.
recommended_fix: Unit-test demo_store.competition_ranks directly with the server test's tie, None-tail and offset cases; assert compare_apps sorts a pending analysis last.
